$$\frac{1}{y^2}dy+\left(\frac{2x}{y^3}dx-\frac{3x^2}{y^4}dy\right)=d\left(-\frac{1}{y}\right)+d\left(\frac{x^2}{y^3}\right)=d\left(-\frac{1}{y}+\frac{x^2}{y^3}\right),$$
